j.note: Reviews disagree (A saw x=1 and passed; B saw x=2 and failed), so the result is recorded as fail.

summary: Tiny probe: 2 parallel agents, then a dependent judge, then a 2-round loop; checks what files appear during a run

workflowProgress.label: reviewer:A
workflowProgress.promptPreview: Reply with verdict "pass" and note "A saw x=1". Do not use any tools.

workflowProgress.label: reviewer:B
workflowProgress.promptPreview: Reply with verdict "fail" and note "B saw x=2". Do not use any tools.

workflowProgress.label: judge
workflowProgress.promptPreview: Two reviews: [{"verdict":"pass","note":"A saw x=1"},{"verdict":"fail","note":"B saw x=2"}]. They disagree. Reply verdict "fail" with a one-line note. No tools.
workflowProgress.resultPreview: {"verdict":"fail","note":"Reviews disagree (A saw x=1 and passed; B saw x=2 and failed), so the result is recorded as fail."}

workflowProgress.label: fixer:round1
